tuning.study_policy: Four fresh studies; identical generic initial recipe/search space/sampler seed for both bit lengths. No V7 trials or best parameters imported.
tuning.objective: mean per-label mean-fold Average Precision on all 109 training-supported labels
tuning.stop_rule: Fixed 16 active hours per study; no score-based extension. Preserve best completed trial by each 8/16-hour boundary.
tuning.incomplete_trial_policy: Interrupted trial marked FAIL; elapsed computation remains charged; completed trials and sampler retained.

robustness.scope: all eight main candidates, plus the 8-hour recipes when different from 16-hour recipes
robustness.selection_metric: mean macro AP across five repeated grouped-CV seeds
robustness.interpretation: not nested CV; descriptive development evidence, not an unbiased generalization estimate

threshold_selection.source: mean repeated grouped out-of-fold validation probabilities

status: prepared for campus; research training not started
research_status: V7 locked; V8 pre-ML exploration; V9 is a separate exploratory follow-up.

features.source: Frozen V7 2048 + MD8; exact OR-fold to frozen 1024 verified on all rows.

test_access: All recipes, repeated CV and OOF thresholds frozen before final fitting/test; eight main candidates only.
confirmatory_status: Exploratory follow-up; historical test has been inspected. Repeated CV is not nested or independent confirmation. No automatic replacement of V7 or superiority claim over Suh.
next_action: Audit all results including declines; compare bits and 8/16-hour validation snapshots. V7 remains locked.

budget_comparison.method: Within-study 8/16-hour best-completed snapshots; same repeated grouped CV
budget_comparison.same_recipe: Reuse identical 16-hour CV result with explicit marker; do not refit identical recipe.
budget_comparison.no_complete_trial_at_8h: Report unavailable; do not substitute a trial completed after 8h.
budget_comparison.selection: 8-hour snapshots are descriptive only, not candidate selection or test evaluation.
